nodes.description: Ownable owner address; controls privileged functions and is compared against msg.sender in onlyOwner/hasMintPermission.
Mapping of holder address to token balance in BasicToken.
Internal total token supply mutated by mint.
Nested allowance mapping(address=>address=>uint256) in StandardToken.
Boolean flag gating canMint and canTransfer modifiers.
Maximum mintable supply bound in CappedToken.
Secondary address permitted to mint in WarfieldToken.
Constant 2500000000e18 used as the cap value at construction.
BasicToken.transfer: authorization via balances[msg.sender] and SafeMath sub/add.
StandardToken.transferFrom: spends allowance allowed[_from][msg.sender] and moves balances.
StandardToken.approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
StandardToken.increaseApproval: SafeMath add on allowance.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval: conditional SafeMath sub on allowance.
MintableToken.mint: hasMintPermission+canMint, adds to totalSupply_ and balances.
MintableToken.finishMinting: onlyOwner+canMint, irreversibly disables minting.
CappedToken.mint: requires totalSupply_.add(_amount) <= cap then delegates to super.mint.
TokenRecoverable.recoverTokens: onlyOwner, performs external ERC20 safeTransfer to arbitrary 'to'.
WarfieldToken.transfer: canTransfer gated, blocks self-transfer, delegates to super.
WarfieldToken.transferFrom: canTransfer gated, blocks self-transfer, delegates to super.
WarfieldToken.mint: hasMintPermission+canMint, rejects address(0), delegates upward.
WarfieldToken.mintTokens: batch mint loop over receivers/amounts, permission and canMint gated.
WarfieldToken.setTokenMinter: onlyOwner assignment of privileged minter address.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner, delegates to internal _transferOwnership.
SafeMath.sub: assert(_b <= _a) then subtraction, used for balance/allowance decrements.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization and mapping keys.
totalSupply_ = totalSupply_.add(_amount) supply mutation in mint path.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) state-mutating subtraction.
External call token.safeTransfer(to, amount) to an attacker-supplied token contract.
Unbounded-by-value loop in mintTokens repeatedly adding to totalSupply_ and balances.
Parameter _to: destination address for transfers.
Parameter _value: amount of tokens to transfer.
Parameter _from: source address of transferFrom.
Parameter _spender: allowance beneficiary in approve/increase/decreaseApproval.
Parameter _amount: mint quantity.
Parameter _receivers: batched recipient address array in mintTokens.
Parameter _amounts: batched mint quantity array in mintTokens.
Local oldValue snapshot of the allowance in decreaseApproval.
Loop index i in mintTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to index balances for the from-account authorization in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender] during transferFrom.
approve authorizes by writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseApproval mutates the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
decreaseApproval mutates the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
hasMintPermission modifier requires msg.sender == owner before minting.
onlyOwner modifier gates setTokenMinter on msg.sender == owner.
Overridden hasMintPermission accepts msg.sender == owner or tokenMinter.
hasMintPermission gates the batch mintTokens entry point on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates token recovery on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner gates ownership transfer on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner gates finishMinting on msg.sender == owner.
transfer decrements balances[msg.sender] via SafeMath sub.
MintableToken.mint increases totalSupply_ via SafeMath add.
mintTokens repeatedly calls mint, inflating totalSupply_ per loop iteration.
recoverTokens passes the owner-controlled 'to' and attacker-supplied token into an external safeTransfer.
The external call to an untrusted ERC20Basic token can re-enter recoverTokens before state settles.
_to destination parameter flows into transfer.
_value amount parameter flows into transfer balance math.
_to flows through the WarfieldToken.transfer override.
_value flows through the WarfieldToken.transfer override.
_from parameter keys balances and allowed in transferFrom.
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve.
_amount is added to totalSupply_ and compared against cap.
_amount flows into the WarfieldToken.mint override.
_receivers array length and elements drive the mintTokens loop.
_amounts array supplies per-iteration mint quantities in mintTokens.
oldValue local snapshot is compared and subtracted in decreaseApproval.
loop index i bounds the mintTokens iteration.
totalSupply_ is read and added to _amount for the cap check.
cap is the upper bound in the post-mint supply comparison.
canMint requires !mintingFinished before batch minting.
canTransfer requires mintingFinished before transfers.
canTransfer requires mintingFinished before transferFrom.
tokenMinter is compared against msg.sender in WarfieldToken hasMintPermission.
tokenMinter is an accepted caller for the mintTokens batch function.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
allowed nested mapping is consumed and decremented by transferFrom.
owner is compared with msg.sender in the onlyOwner guard of recoverTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a pure pass-through destination of BasicToken.transfer and has no independent semantics.
_value only parameterizes the SafeMath balance subtraction in transfer.
_from is only a mapping key for balances/allowed inside transferFrom.
_spender is only a mapping key for the allowance write in approve.
_amount only feeds the cap check arithmetic in CappedToken.mint.
_receivers only bounds and indexes the mintTokens loop.
_amounts only supplies per-iteration values for the mintTokens loop.
oldValue is a transient snapshot used only inside decreaseApproval.
i is a transient loop counter used only inside mintTokens.
